details.name: Tuareg Voice Probe
details.summary: Selection and attack native speech routing test
details.description:
Solo native speech routing experiment.
Map: Dry Arabia; player 1 Malian human, player 2 Malian AI.
Tuning Pack and Game Mode: Tuareg Voice Probe.
The two private squads appear near player 1. At 90 seconds, player 1 advances to Imperial Age.
This fixture uses only the new selection and attack clips; native acceptance is unverified.
details.changelog: Use World_Pos for typed spawn/facing positions; preserve permitted TOCs. Native voice resolution remains experimental.
